title: 農夫の一手
change: コウの迂回操作とセラの水術で守衛への供水が減り、関節の圧が落ちる。ロウが露出した制御核を割って停止させる。四階の未攻略分岐を突破し、三人の貢献を描く。作物の枯死を瞬間化しない。
state: コウの迂回操作とセラの水術で守衛への供水が減り、関節の圧が落ちる。ロウが露出した制御核を割って停止させる。四階の未攻略分岐を突破し、三人の貢献を描く。作物の枯死を瞬間化しない。

sources.description: Tight connected work action Kou braces boots at manual gate and pulls stuck handle, visible soil and grit jam track; guardian threatens from distant left where Row shields. Gloved hand and face alternating closeups, no gate moves magically by thought.
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Kou uses small shovel to scrape jammed gritty track, then places wood wedge to gain leverage safely. Two fast hand closeups in right-to-left pair, Row keeps sword defense behind, fingers never under sliding gate.
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Gate shifts and stream diverts into side return trough. Sera teal cloak black braid controls existing flow, blue magic gently guided along water rather than giant tsunami, her strained face then current visibly takes new route.
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Guardian water-bright arm seam thins, bent wooden joints slacken, armor plate shifts revealing small blue carved control stone at chest. NOT organic plant rotting or instant desiccation. Kou sees it and calls to Row; guardian still capable of last swipe.
dialogue:
今だ！
胸の核が見えた
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Large diagonal action Row dodges slowed root swipe, Sera holds diverted stream, Kou stands at gate maintaining wedge. Clear positions and single ordinary steel sword connects with exposed blue control stone. No unexplained new weapon or protagonist duplicate.
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Blue stone splits and guardian slumps motionless across garden edge, water slows to ordinary trickle. Borderless broad aftermath shows safe passage clear; quiet separated closeups Kou releases breath and Sera lowers exhausted staff. No gore, no new threat immediately.
sources.scrollPurpose: 戦闘の音が消え停止と生還を受け止める

sources.description: Row sheaths intact sword and offers hand to Kou who steps back from locked gate; Sera joins quietly. Big faces then full three-person achievement tableau, roles all credited, no money reward yet.
dialogue:
君がいなければ
また引き返してた

守ってくれたから
触れたんだ

三人で
開けた道だよ
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める

sources.description: Only now reveal intact old growing beds beyond cleared guard, small pale blue-veined leaf crop with dry mature seed pods, not giant magic cabbage. Kou kneels looking with wonder, Row and Sera behind at safe cleared doorway. Floor5 branch arch visible distant but not entered.
dialogue:
ここにも
畑があったのか

持ち帰れる物が
あるかもしれない
sources.scrollPurpose: 行動と反応をつなぎ成果を受け止める
